|lore=Ortolan musician and gambler. Head of The Max Rebo Band. Signed a lifetime contract to Jabba in exchange for unlimited food.
|game_text=Power +2 on Hoth. If at same site as another of you musicians, you may play Bith Shuffle to cancel a Force drain at an adjacent site. While at Audience Chamber, all your other musicians are deploy -1 and forfeit +3.
|joke=Max Rebo is an Ortolan, one of the "Squat, floppy-eared food lovers" from "the frigid planet Orto" of the [[Ortolan]] card. He signs himself to Jabba for life in exchange for food, and like the Ortolan card he is stronger on Hoth. See [[Jokes#Max Rebo|Jokes]].

|combos=* [[Max Rebo]] vs. [[Walker Garrison]] - If played correctly, Max can be the centerpiece of a deck which has to play against AT-AT's a lot.
